checks.command:
channel=$(awk -F= '/^TELEGRAM_HOME_CHANNEL=-?[0-9]+$/ {v=$2} END {print v}' "${HERMES_HOME:-$HOME/.hermes}/.env"); [ -n "$channel" ] || { printf 'FAIL Telegram home channel unavailable
'; exit 1; }; expected=$(tail -n +3 "${THESYSTEM_CLONE:-$HOME/theSystem}/agents/.harness/personalities/telegram.md"); actual=$(hermes config get "telegram.channel_prompts.$channel" 2>/dev/null) || { printf 'FAIL Telegram prompt unavailable
'; exit 1; }; if [ "$actual" = "$expected" ]; then printf 'OK Telegram prompt matches source
'; else printf 'FAIL Telegram prompt drift
'; exit 1; fi

safe_state.switch: hold the configured Telegram channel prompt unchanged
safe_state.description: Do not overwrite or remove a per-channel prompt on drift; the channel is instance-specific and its intended value requires human confirmation.

sampling.what: Daily equality result between the configured home-channel prompt and the canonical Telegram prompt, excluding channel identifiers and prompt contents from output.
sampling.working_well: The effective configured value matches the canonical prompt or the check reports a generic drift/unavailable status without disclosing the channel identifier.

open_decisions: Confirm that the home channel ID source remains HERMES_HOME/.env and that the current clone is the intended prompt baseline.
